name: No Other Medicine
source:
No Other Medicine is a short visual novel (roughly half an hour) created for the 2017 TyranoBuilder Spring Game Jam, with the theme of "fresh starts". It's about the potential beginning of a new friendship between Jess, a lonely and awkward PhD student, and Sybil, a snarky and sarcastic former student of the same university.

[From [url=https://janetitor.itch.io/no-other-medicine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《没有其他药物》是一部时长约半小时的短篇视觉小说，为2017年TyranoBuilder春季创作大赛制作，主题是“重新开始”。故事讲述一段新友谊可能如何萌芽：杰茜是一名孤独而笨拙的博士生，西比尔则是同一所大学的尖刻、讽刺的前学生。

[来源：[url=https://janetitor.itch.io/no-other-medicine]itch.io[/url]]
